description:
## [1.66.0](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/compare/v1.65.0...v1.66.0) (2026-10-29)

### Bug Fixes

* **AutomaTag - Unlock premium:** save tags without the unlicensed error ([70b04fe](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/70b04fe0124aee5574a6eb731b94ea27681798c0)), closes [#481](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/issues/481)
* **BeReal - Custom location:** show chosen place before posting ([5d0ab4f](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/5d0ab4fb3a3d009f874e1cff3f1ee79671cc701d))
* **BeReal - Remove late flag:** keep capture time of bonus BeReals ([7b3b6d8](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/7b3b6d80d5303ef8a74bbff900e800f264c12e4c))
* **MovieBox - All-In-One:** bypass blacklisted device ids ([70faeb3](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/70faeb385c7ef782c63f33151ee3c3581d85afa1))
* **MovieBox - All-In-One:** list direct links for HD download rows ([0dd1de6](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/0dd1de661fc0fca04f6f2fc0a4255bde1b982bfe))
* **MovieBox - All-In-One:** play titles whose only file is an HD row ([493104d](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/493104d53937974ee8b1460f931da9cba81610bb))
* **Proton Authenticator - AMOLED dark theme:** show black launch screen ([98d7026](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/98d7026d326382c0f2f3f77c206f2070b7be9386))
* **Proton VPN - AMOLED dark theme:** show a black launch screen ([45a114c](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/45a114cb5faa9813ce2950bdaff5e18c751e299c)), closes [#389](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/issues/389)

### New Features

* **BeReal - Custom retake count:** type any retake count ([6dde0fa](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/6dde0faf9bd1f998f1435060c289a8beca7c677a))
* **Clip Studio Paint - Skip plan selection:** open in doodle mode ([900640b](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/900640b9a9b34481b8a5783ec3a025be19bfee48)), closes [#455](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/issues/455)
* **Moon+ Reader - Unlock pro:** add the home screen widget ([a6d19d5](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/a6d19d55a3c3ce94955c0490c03a7dab4ba1a0ab)), closes [#474](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/issues/474)
* **Resprite - Unlock premium:** unlock every premium tool ([c8f5f20](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/c8f5f20b7f06d3f3492a7227cf1dbc6855628b51))
